notes.title: New Gem Venture demo is out now!
notes.notes:
In case you haven't heard already, there's an improved Gem Venture demo for Steam Next Fest!
You can try out 6 levels from a few different worlds across the land of Aventurine!

Since the demo is focused on the gameplay, no story elements are in this demo for now.
Some of the later levels might be a bit more difficult based on how leveled up you are, but if you're skilled enough it shouldn't be a problem. 😎

If you're having issues with the game not starting, try downloading the all-in-one VC++ package: https://www.techpowerup.com/download/visual-c-redistributable-runtime-package-all-in-one/


Also, there still might be a few bugs that need to be fixed in the full game, but if you find any in the demo please let me know down below!

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080890/Gem_Venture/

I hope you all enjoy it!
